images.alt_grc: ἅμα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ οἱ Ἀθηναῖοι εἰς τὴν Πύκνα ἀναβαίνουσιν.
images.alt_en: Dawn: citizens in himatia climb the rocky Pnyx; on the neighbouring hill Lysis and Syros sit and watch.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Δημόκριτος ἐπὶ τῷ βήματι λέγει· «μαχώμεθα!»
images.alt_en: Demokritos on the speaker's platform, fist raised, the crowd on the slope before him; the prytaneis seated at the side, the herald with his staff.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Κλεινίας γέρων ὢν λέγει· «τὰς ναῦς πληρῶμεν.»
images.alt_en: Old Kleinias on the platform pointing towards the sea and the harbour; the crowd divided, some shouting, some nodding.

images.alt_grc: ἀνήρ τις ἐκ Πλαταιῶν ἥκει καὶ τὰ ἐν Πλαταιαῖς λέγει.
images.alt_en: A dusty traveller on the platform tells the Assembly about the night attack on Plataea; the listeners lean forward.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Ἀρίστων φοβεῖται· νεανίας δέ τις ἐν δέλτῳ γράφει.
images.alt_en: Ariston and Demokritos on the slope, anxious; beside them a young man writes on a folding wax tablet.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Θουκυδίδης λέγει· «ἐγὼ τὸν πόλεμον συγγράψω.»
images.alt_en: The young Thucydides looks out over the city and the sea, tablet in hand, as if already seeing the long war he will write down.

images.alt_grc: οἱ Ἀθηναῖοι χειροτονοῦσιν· αἱ χεῖρες ὅμοιαι δένδροις εἰσίν.
images.alt_en: The vote: a forest of raised hands on the Pnyx slope; the prytaneis stand and look; Demokritos, arms folded, in the minority.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Λύσις πρὸς τὸν πατέρα τρέχει· «τί ἔδοξε τῷ δήμῳ;»
images.alt_en: Men coming down from the Pnyx; Lysis runs to his father, Syros following at a walk.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Ἀρίστων τὰ μακρὰ τείχη καὶ τὸν Πειραιᾶ δείκνυσιν.
images.alt_en: From the hill Ariston points out the Long Walls running to Piraeus and the ships in the harbour; Lysis follows his arm.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Περικλῆς ἐπὶ τὸ βῆμα ἀναβαίνει· ὁ δῆμος σιγᾷ.
images.alt_en: Pericles, in a general's helmet pushed back on his head, mounts the platform; the crowd falls silent.

images.alt_grc: «τὰ ἐκ τῶν ἀγρῶν εἰσκομίζετε, καὶ τὸ ναυτικὸν παρασκευάζετε.»
images.alt_en: Pericles speaking, one hand towards the countryside, the other towards the sea and the fleet.

images.alt_grc: ἑσπέρας ὁ Δημόκριτος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ Ἀρίστωνος λέγει.
images.alt_en: Evening in the courtyard: Demokritos, tired, with Ariston, Kleinias and the children; outside, a cart loaded with doors and timber passes.

images.alt_grc: ἡ ἐκκλησία
images.alt_en: The Assembly: citizens seated on a hillside facing a speaker on a stone platform.

images.alt_grc: ὁ κῆρυξ
images.alt_en: A herald holding the herald's staff (kerykeion), calling out.

images.alt_grc: ὁ στρατηγός
images.alt_en: A general: a bearded man in a Corinthian helmet pushed up on his head.

images.alt_grc: χειροτονεῖ
images.alt_en: A citizen raising his right hand to vote.

images.alt_grc: δείκνυσι
images.alt_en: A man pointing something out to a boy.

images.alt_grc: σημεῖον πυρός
images.alt_en: A fire signal blazing on a hilltop tower at night.

images.alt_grc: τὸ χωρίον
images.alt_en: A small farm: a stone house, a threshing floor, vines and olive trees.

images.alt_grc: ἡ τροφή
images.alt_en: Provisions: bread, olives, cheese and a jar of grain.

images.alt_grc: οἱ ἀδελφοί
images.alt_en: Two brothers side by side, clearly alike.

images.alt_grc: εἰσκομίζει
images.alt_en: A farmer bringing sacks and jars through a city gate on a donkey cart.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Θουκυδίδης
images.alt_en: Portrait herm of Thucydides, Roman copy of a Greek original of the early 4th century BC (Holkham Hall type).

images.alt_grc: ἔδοξε τῇ βουλῇ καὶ τῷ δήμῳ
images.alt_en: An Athenian decree inscribed on a marble stele, with a relief at the top and the opening formula ἔδοξε τῇ βουλῇ καὶ τῷ δήμῳ.

images.alt_grc: ὁ Περικλῆς
images.alt_en: Marble bust of Pericles wearing a helmet, Roman copy after a Greek original of about 430 BC attributed to Kresilas.
